Watch Australia vs Cook Islands as the hosts play their final Pool A fixture of Rugby League World Cup 2026 at Queensland Country Bank Stadium, Townsville. The Kangaroos are safely through to the semi-finals, whereas Cook Islands will head home following this match after losing their opening two games.
Australia remain heavy favorites to claim a fourth successive Rugby League World Cup title, but they have yet to hit top gear at the tournament. After edging past New Zealand 24-22, they were staring down the barrel of a shock defeat by Fiji last time out in Brisbane when their opponents crossed to go 20-12 up in the second half – only for the try to be disallowed and the Kangaroos to eventually triumph 36-22. While certain elements of the performance were unconvincing, there were also positives to take, with debutant Sam Walker scoring 16 points. Coach Kevin Walters has opted for eight changes with Reece Walsh returning at fullback, Tom Dearden at halfback and Ethan Strange named on the bench ahead of a potential Test debut.
The big storyline for Cook Islands is former Aussie Valentine Holmes returning to face the country for whom he won two World Cups with. The NRL star still holds the record for the most tries in a single match at the tournament, crossing six times against Fiji in 2017, and will relish facing Australia in Townsville, the city of his birth. Cook Islands briefly threatened a stunning victory against New Zealand last time out when they roared back from 12-0 down to lead 16-12, with Esom Ioka scoring a hat-trick. However, they ultimately lost 82-16 and now face the daunting task of trying to stop the 12-time champions.
